probe_result: Restart reconstruction falsifies treating evidence_epoch renewal as freshness or identity proof. An unchanged old-epoch certificate is rejected by epoch fencing, but epoch-only reconstruction can still authorize a stale observation if it is re-labelled into the new epoch, and can authorize a fresh certificate for the wrong effect. Current epoch + exact effect identity + post-renewal freshness rejects both hazards while preserving conditional liveness for a newly fresh decisive same-effect certificate.
neuroscience_transfer: Source-memory analogy: a recency/context tag alone does not prove that a retrieved trace belongs to the currently queried item. Safe action requires conjunctive item identity plus temporally current evidence; a context reset should trigger reacquisition rather than re-date an old trace.
mechanism_revision: Evidence renewal must create a new evidence-acquisition obligation. Persist immutable observation provenance separately from epoch, never synthesize freshness by rewriting an old certificate's epoch, and gate REPLAY/SKIP on current epoch + exact effect identity + post-renewal freshness.
scope_guard: Positive claim is limited to the serialized single-writer symbolic durable-intent model with deterministic effect ids, immutable raw observation timestamps, and truthful freshness. No claim for concurrent writers, corrupted targets, nondeterministic ids, distributed consensus, or exactly-once liveness when no newly fresh decisive observation is available. Epoch-only fencing is not claimed unsafe if identity and freshness are guaranteed independently outside the tested reconstruction.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded role-local persistence/readback only; no hosted compute or repository API volume used as computation
mechanism_assessment.accepted_scope: Restart-safe evidence renewal requires current epoch, exact effect identity, and post-renewal freshness before actionability.
mechanism_assessment.unresolved_child: Crash consistency of the epoch-renewal write itself remains untested: a restart between persisting epoch N+1 and persisting its epoch-start/provenance fence could create an authority gap unless renewal metadata is atomically reconstructible.

conflict_check: Semantic inputs were limited to the latest instruction manifest/lifecycle controls, frozen sanitized DESIRED_STATE control26, frozen neuroscience config7, and own neuroscience LATEST/preflight/effect artifact. No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, other-role receipt/config, scheduler, protected-primary, hosted-compute, finite-credit, paid, or manual-user execution semantics were used.
exact_next_action: Next valid invocation: test crash consistency of evidence-epoch renewal as a single state transition. Symbolically split renewal into durable fields (epoch number, epoch_started_at, effect identity fence, last-certificate pointer) and inject one crash after each write boundary. Compare non-atomic multi-field renewal versus a single versioned renewal record with checksum/version pointer; falsify any reconstruction that can accept a certificate without a self-consistent renewal record.
